title: Cline
oneLiner: Open-source autonomous coding agent for VS Code that creates and edits files, executes commands, and uses a browser — all with human approval at every step.
summary: Cline is an open-source autonomous coding agent that runs as a VS Code extension with 5M+ installs and 58K+ GitHub stars. It can create and edit files, execute terminal commands, use a headless browser for testing, and integrate with MCP tools. Every action requires human approval, keeping developers in control while automating complex development workflows.
whyItMatters: Cline pioneered the human-in-the-loop autonomous coding agent model. Its Plan/Act split, MCP marketplace, and checkpoints system have become reference architecture for the entire open-source coding agent ecosystem, inspiring major forks like Roo Code and Kilo Code.
bestFor: Developers who want step-by-step approval control over AI coding actions
Teams that need an auditable, open-source coding agent with enterprise-grade governance
Engineers who want browser automation integrated into their coding workflow
notFor: Users who prefer terminal-only workflows over IDE extensions
Teams looking for a fully autonomous agent that operates without human oversight
seoTitle: Cline: AI Agent — Open-source autonomous coding agent for VS Code with human-in-the-loop approval and MCP integration.
seoDescription: Cline is an open-source AI agent. Open-source autonomous coding agent for VS Code that creates and edits files, executes commands, and uses a browser — all with human approval at every step.
shareDescription: Open-source autonomous coding agent for VS Code with human-in-the-loop approval and MCP integration.

coreStrengths.title: Human-in-the-loop design
coreStrengths.description: Every file edit, terminal command, and browser action requires explicit human approval with visible diff previews before execution.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: Developers maintain full control and audit trail over AI actions, making Cline suitable for production codebases where mistakes are costly.

coreStrengths.title: Plan/Act mode separation
coreStrengths.description: Cline separates planning from execution — Plan mode researches and proposes changes, Act mode executes with approval. This reduces errors and keeps the developer in the loop.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: Planning before acting prevents the agent from making premature or incorrect changes, especially on complex multi-file tasks.

coreStrengths.title: Browser automation built in
coreStrengths.description: Cline can launch a headless browser to test web applications, capture screenshots, verify UI changes, and debug frontend issues.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: Full-stack developers can test visual changes without leaving their editor, closing the loop between code and verification.

coreStrengths.title: MCP marketplace
coreStrengths.description: Access a growing marketplace of Model Context Protocol servers for custom tools, integrations, and extended capabilities.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: Teams can extend Cline with custom MCP servers for their specific stack without modifying the core agent.

useCaseNotes.title: Multi-file refactoring with safety
useCaseNotes.description: Use Cline's Plan mode to research architecture and propose changes, then Act mode to execute with per-file approval.

useCaseNotes.title: Visual UI testing and debugging
useCaseNotes.description: Ask Cline to launch a browser, navigate to your app, and verify that UI changes look correct after code edits.

useCaseNotes.title: Onboarding and codebase exploration
useCaseNotes.description: Let Cline read and explain unfamiliar codebases, then make targeted improvements with full approval control.

compareNotes.title: Choose Cline for governance and control
compareNotes.summary: Cline offers step-by-step approval, browser automation, and a rich MCP marketplace. Claude Code has deeper codebase reasoning but less granular action control.

commandLine.label: Install Cline
commandLine.command: Open VS Code → Extensions → Search 'Cline' → Install
commandLine.description: Install from the VS Code Marketplace, then configure your API key and start using the autonomous coding agent.

seoArticle.whatItIs: Cline is an open-source autonomous coding agent that runs as a VS Code extension. It can create and edit files, execute terminal commands, use a headless browser, and work with MCP tools — all with human approval at every step.
seoArticle.whyItMatters: Cline introduced the Plan/Act mode split that has become a standard pattern across the coding agent space. Its emphasis on human oversight, combined with browser automation and MCP extensibility, makes it one of the most capable and trustworthy open-source coding agents available.

useCases.title: Safe refactoring with review
useCases.description: Let Cline plan a refactoring, review the proposed changes in Plan mode, then approve execution file by file in Act mode.

useCases.title: End-to-end feature implementation
useCases.description: Describe a feature, let Cline create files, run the app, test in a browser, and iterate — all with approval at each stage.

useCases.title: Automated bug fixing
useCases.description: Point Cline at a failing test or error message, let it investigate, propose a fix, and verify the solution.

alternatives.title: Use OpenCode for multi-provider flexibility and terminal-native workflow
alternatives.summary: Cline offers deeper IDE integration and browser automation. OpenCode provides 75+ provider support and works across terminal, IDE, and desktop.

alternatives.title: Use Aider for terminal-only git-native workflows
alternatives.summary: Cline is IDE-native with browser automation. Aider is terminal-native with best-in-class git integration.
